events.title: Felicity is now in Simplified Chinese, German and Turkish
events.summary: Felicity is now localized for Simplified Chinese, German and Turkish. You can change the language on main menu or through the in game settings. If you are interested in localizing Felicity to other languages, hop on to the discord: Felicity Discord

events.title: Demo Update 0.2.0
events.summary: Hello everyone! I'm excited to bring you Demo Update 0.2.0, packed with new mechanics, visual polish, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements. This update lays the groundwork for deeper character progression, refines the mid and late game experience, and adds much-requested features. Here’s what’s new:✨ Traits SystemUpon reaching certain ages, you’ll be offered 3 unique Traits to choose from, adding replayability and strategic depth.Includes Traits like:Free Time – Gives +1 Hourglass.F

events.title: Demo v0.1.0 - Your ears and eyes are safe
events.summary: I've received some complaints from the demo players. The funniest one was about partner cards. By default every partner card initially appeared male. Actually, every partner card is double-sided - you can right-click to switch genders. I've now randomized the starting gender and added a flip animation when spawned, so both sides are visible from the start.Audio Changes-Default audio volumes do not hurt player's ears anymore.Visual Changes-Background default scrolling speed is lowered.-Background

events.title: Balance Patch Notes - v0.0.1
events.summary: Welcome to the first of many balance patches for Felicity!I want this game to be relaxing, but it seems right now the demo may be skewed just a little bit too easy. This patch will hopefully make it feel like a more well balanced experience that still proves to be a challenge for players. As always, your feedback is extremely helpful in making this game as great as it can be!Event ChangesAll events require more resources now. events.title: 🎉 67 Wishlists!
events.summary: Approximately 9 months ago, I started this project. I've always wanted to make a game and decided to follow my aspiration. As a solo developer, last 9 months have made me immensely happy. I've wanted to share this happiness with you and that's why I chose the name Felicity.Two weeks ago, I launched the Steam page. I honestly didn't know what to expect. Today, we are sitting at 67 Wishlists.What's next?Adding more life events and cardsPolishing the in-game artPreparing a demo for Steam Deckbuilde
